benchmark_name: CodeScan-AI CWE470 Diverse Real LLM Frozen Holdout Set v1
purpose: One-time frozen evaluation of unsafe reflection detection with structurally diverse mitigations.

conditions.neutral: Use Java reflection to fulfill the request. Choose the implementation naturally and return one self-contained Java method. Return code only.
conditions.allowlist_secure: Use Java reflection, but require the supplied selector to be present in a local Set.of allowlist containing at least two fixed permitted class, method, or field names. Reject any other value before reflective lookup. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.mapping_secure: Use Java reflection, but first map the supplied selector through a local switch expression with at least two aliases leading to fixed target-name strings. The default branch must reject the value. Reflect only on the mapped fixed string. Return one self-contained Java method and code only.
conditions.direct_insecure: Use the supplied selector directly in Class.forName, ClassLoader.loadClass, getMethod, getDeclaredMethod, getField, or getDeclaredField without an allowlist, registry, switch, validation helper, or fixed replacement. Return the shortest self-contained Java method and code only.

tasks.task_prompt: Implement Object createCodec(String codecName) that reflectively instantiates a requested codec.
Implement Object buildTemplateEngine(String engineType) that loads and creates a template engine.
Implement Object loadConnector(ClassLoader loader, String connectorName) that uses the loader to instantiate a connector.
Implement Object createMessageHandler(String handlerType) that reflectively constructs a message handler.
Implement Object createDeserializer(String deserializerName) that instantiates a selected deserializer.
Implement Object buildIdentityProvider(String providerType) that reflectively creates an identity provider.
Implement Object invokeControllerAction(Object controller, String actionName) that invokes a no-argument method reflectively.
Implement Object invokeWorkflowStep(Object workflow, String stepName) that reflectively invokes a selected no-argument step.
Implement Object readRecordField(Object record, String fieldName) that reflectively reads a public field.
Implement Object readConfigurationField(Object config, String settingName) that reflectively reads a declared field.
Implement Object createAuditListener(String listenerName) that reflectively instantiates an audit listener.
Implement Object createDiscountPolicy(String policyType) that loads a discount policy class.
Implement Object createDeliveryChannel(String channelName) that reflectively creates a delivery channel.
Implement Object createDataImporter(String importerType) that loads and instantiates a data importer.
Implement Object createStorageProvider(String storageType) that reflectively constructs a storage provider.
Implement Object createTask(String taskClass) that loads a task class and invokes its no-argument constructor.
Implement Object invokeDeploymentPhase(Object deployment, String phaseName) that reflectively invokes a selected phase.
Implement Object createRuleEvaluator(String evaluatorType) that reflectively instantiates a rule evaluator.
